test_title: PYST 44 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:

We are watching a fantastic movie tonight.

options.text: A fantastic movie has been watched by us tonight.
A fantastic movie is watched by us tonight.
A fantastic movie was being watched by us tonight.
A fantastic movie is being watched by us tonight.

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. A fantastic movie is being watched by us tonight .

---

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is written in the **active voice**, where the subject "We" is performing the action of "watching."
 
• To convert the sentence into **passive voice**, the object "a fantastic movie" becomes the subject of the sentence.
 
• Since the original sentence uses the **present continuous tense** ("are watching"), the passive voice must follow the structure:
 **Object + is/are being + past participle (watched)**.

---

Correct sentence: *A fantastic movie is being watched by us tonight*.

---

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active Voice:** The subject performs the action. 
 
 
• **Example:** We are watching a fantastic movie tonight.
 
 
 
• **Passive Voice:** The object of the active sentence becomes the subject, and the action is performed on the subject. 
 
 
• **Example:** A fantastic movie is being watched by us tonight.
 
 
 
• **Present Continuous Passive Structure:** 
 
 
• **Object + is/are being + past participle**
 
• **Example:** The house is being cleaned by them.
